details.description: Experience the mouth-watering taste of Dahi Papdi Chaat in a new and exciting form with Too Yumm!'s delectable multigrain chips. These baked, not fried chips offer a delightful fusion of flavours, blending the classic and unique Indian cuisine taste of tangy dahi papdi chaat with the crunchy goodness of multigrain. Made with a blend of wholesome grains, these chips are a healthier alternative to traditional potato crisps, providing the nourishment of protein and 40% less fat. Convenient to order online and delivered straight to your door, these irresistible multigrain snacks are perfect for satisfying your cravings anytime. Indulge in the mouthwatering experience of this beloved street food flavour, now in a guilt-free, on-the-go form.
details.ingredients: Corn Flour (31%), Whole Wheat Flour (Atta) (22%), Edible Vegetable Oil (Rice Bran Oil), Rice Flour (18%), Seasoning [Sugar, Iodised Salt, Spices & Condiments, Black Salt, Acidity Regulators (INS 330, INS 334), Milk Solids, Anticaking Agent (INS 551), Natural And Nature Identical Flavouring Substances, Stabilizer (INS 414), Flavour Enhancers (INS 627, INS 631)], Gram Flour (5%), Oats (1%), Anticaking Agent (INS 170), Colour (INS 150d)
